title: Basal dendrites take feedforward input, apical dendrites take feedback

statements.text: The basal compartment of layer 5 pyramidal neurons receives mostly feedforward information about the feature processed in its column, while long-range feedback from other cortical areas and nonspecific thalamus reaches mostly the apical compartment, carrying context about processes elsewhere in the brain.

sources.quote: DIT hypothesizes firstly that the basal compartment of these neurons receives predominantly feedforward information
long-range feedback information impinges predominantly on the apical compartment
the apical tuft receives diverse input from higher cortical areas and NSP thalamic nuclei
